hero.title: Italiano, sul serio.
hero.blurb: Eighteen weeks. Short daily lessons. A buddy who walks you from total beginner to the doorstep of C1 — the full congiuntivo, real conditionals, formal and street Italian, irony and all — in real, standard Italian.

bullets.text: allora, dai, magari. National standard, not a phrasebook.
12 weeks to B1, then a B2 → C1 arc that finishes the job.
15 to 35 minutes, sized to fit your day.
your progress saves to this device.

levels.title: A1 Foundations
levels.blurb: Greet, introduce yourself, order coffee, describe your day.

levels.title: A2 Building
levels.blurb: Tell stories in the past. Travel, health, everyday life.

levels.title: B1 Threshold
levels.blurb: Opinions, hypotheticals, real conversations — and stepping into the congiuntivo.

levels.title: B2 Depth
levels.blurb: Finish the congiuntivo, master conditionals and regret, handle formal and professional Italian, and tell layered stories.

levels.title: C1 Gateway
levels.blurb: Irony, register-switching, regional ears, real reading — the run-up to C1. Preparing the leap, honestly, not certifying it.
